faq.q: What is the origin of Budi?
faq.a: Budi is associated with Indonesian. Budi is Javanese, meaning 'reason, wisdom'. It is used as a male given name in Indonesia.
No — the underlying form is Indonesian, not Arabic.
Budi can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Indonesian-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Budi should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Budi is a Javanese word, not a Quranic Arabic form.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Budi, budi. Script forms are بودي, بودی, بُودِي, बुदी.

faq.q: Is Budi a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
